host: Roblox Studio 0.740 playtest, Facet Showcase place with sources injected over HTTP, device emulator Xbox One 1920x1080, Controller Emulator (Virtual Controller) on
mainCommit: bc9a56a6 (local instrumentation only: Facet_Focused and Facet_Scope workspace attributes, a FacetPath attribute on rendered nodes, a VirtualMonitorsAPI mode switch)

keyMap.DPadUp: not injectable (Studio VirtualInput refuses it as a core-bound key); the left stick up key W is used on both sides
keyMap.Tab: not injectable; the Facet Traverse input action is fired in the live client

recording: After each press a client probe prints GuiService.SelectedObject (PR) or the main focus path and its rendered node (main). PR routes with the prefix fixed/ ran with this branch's fixes; the other PR routes ran on the unfixed base.

divergences.route: first D-pad press with nothing selected
divergences.main: focus already on the first control; the press moves from it
divergences.prBefore: nothing selected; D-pad does nothing until ButtonSelect
divergences.prAfter: the press selects the first control (gallery: Settings; Virtual Monitors: Discover tab)

divergences.screen: all screens with scroll containers (tab strips, pages, sheet body, alert message, HUD zones)

divergences.prAfter: the container forwards to its entry child (the selected tab for a TabView strip) or passes to the next control
divergences.fix: selection.luau forward and beyond; AlertMessage Selectable false; nav_pages FacetEntry attribute

divergences.prBefore: Up selects AlertMessage and Right/Left stay there

divergences.route: A, Down, Right, Down, Left, B
divergences.main: Right opens the Layering submenu, Left returns to Layering
divergences.prBefore: Right and Left do nothing (engine selection consumes the D-pad before the MenuRight/MenuLeft input actions)
divergences.prAfter: Right opens the submenu (Clothing), Left returns to Layering; B restores Tap

divergences.prAfter: 40 to 45 to 50 to 45; Down moves on

divergences.prAfter: Up reaches Spatial mode then the Avatar tab
